title: Leo & The Lost Library Book: Keeping Promises!

lines.text: Leo checked out a spectacular book about roaring dinosaurs from the library!
lines.caps: Leo checked out a spectacular book about roaring *DINOSAURS | from the *LIBRARY!

lines.text: I promise to keep it dry, clean, and return it on Friday! Leo told Librarian Owl.
lines.caps: I promise to keep it dry, clean, and return it on *FRIDAY! | Leo told Librarian *OWL!

lines.text: On Thursday afternoon, he tossed the book into the wet grass while chasing a soccer ball!
lines.caps: On Thursday afternoon, he tossed the book into the wet *GRASS | while chasing a soccer *BALL!

lines.text: Dark storm clouds rolled in, and raindrops began splashing onto the colorful pages!
lines.caps: Dark storm clouds rolled *IN, | and raindrops began splashing onto the colorful *PAGES!

lines.text: Leo remembered his promise, dove across the lawn, and shielded the book with his coat!
lines.caps: Leo remembered his promise, dove across the *LAWN, | and shielded the book with his *COAT!

lines.text: He dried the cover with a soft towel, placed it safely in his backpack, and returned it on time!
lines.caps: He dried the cover with a soft towel, placed it safely in his *BACKPACK, | and returned it on *TIME!

lines.text: Librarian Owl stamped his card with a gold star and said, You are someone we can trust!
lines.caps: Librarian Owl stamped his card with a gold *STAR | and said, You are someone we can *TRUST!

lines.text: Keeping your promises is like building an invisible bridge of trust that never breaks!
lines.caps: Keeping your promises is like building an invisible bridge of *TRUST | that never *BREAKS!
